methodology.engineOrder: Six balanced engine permutations, opposite starting half on second VM

methodology.filesystemCache: OS page cache uncontrolled/warm, never claimed to be cold OS caches
methodology.pairing: Same VM and block for all three variants, independent native cache/output roots
methodology.outliers: No removed samples; every accepted build must match full linked/CDATAs byte inventory
methodology.confidence: VM-stratified paired bootstrap performed by aggregate_cache_speed.py
